_source: Mortis deck (49 cards, codes 10A0401–10A0449): Minor 14 (arrow marker = random direction), Major 14 (number = random Knight / result), Grave 15 (board coordinate, e.g. Eggknight Panzeronion Column placement), Judicium 6 (You Live!, You Died + Massive Peril -5/-9/-12, Dragon's Sacrament).

iconLegend.[Heat!]: blue H icon with exclamation mark (Heat limit / max Heat) - seen only on Push the Limit!

minor.name: Stone Spell
minor.text: Perform a Curse Save (Curse Level +2). Fail: Bane X, where X is the number you failed the Save by.

minor.name: Slime Spell
minor.text: Perform a Curse Save (Curse Level +2). Fail: Bane X, where X is the number you failed the Save by.

minor.name: Restrain
minor.text: Delay all cards in your Cooldown area.

minor.name: Subdue
minor.text: Place 1 random card from your hand into your Cooldown area.

minor.name: Gash
minor.text: Lose -1 [Vigor]. Shuffle this card back into the Mortis deck, then resolve the Peril Check again.

minor.name: Thrown Off-Balance
minor.text: Exhaust all your exhaustable Gear [Gear] cards. If no Gear [Gear] cards were exhausted by this card, Knockdown.

minor.name: Feign Death
minor.text: Immediately Chain Break the Monster Attack, gain the Knockdown (standing up) Condition card.

minor.name: Feint
minor.text: Place 2 Opening [Opening] and/or Break [Break] tokens in the Knight Pool.

minor.name: Insulted
minor.text: Stand up. You may immediately perform a Bonus Attack!

major.name: Stone Hex
major.text: Perform a Curse Save (Curse Level +3). Fail: Bane X, where X is the number you failed the Save by.

major.name: Slime Hex
major.text: Perform a Curse Save (Curse Level +3). Fail: Bane X, where X is the number you failed the Save by. Gain the Slimed Condition card.

major.name: Heroic Death
major.text:
First Round Only: Ignore this card and draw the Feign Death Minor Mortis card instead.
Any Other Round: You die, but you won't sell your life cheap! Immediately stand up, move up to 3 spaces and perform a Bonus Attack! Then, shuffle this card back into the Mortis deck and die.

major.name: Smother
major.text: Delay all cards in your Cooldown area. If no card was delayed, suffer Knockdown.

major.name: Impair
major.text: Discard 1 random card from your hand.

major.name: Inner Strength
major.text: Lose -2 [Heat]. Stand up. You may immediately perform a Bonus Attack!

major.name: Show of Willpower
major.text: You may discard 1 Condition card. If you don't, lose -2 [Heat] instead.

major.name: Counterattack
major.text: Stand up. Refresh 1. You may immediately move up to 3 spaces and perform a Bonus Attack!

major.name: Priestly Cunning
major.text: Place 3 Opening [Opening] and/or Break [Break] tokens in the Knight Pool.

major.name: Giant Gash
major.text: Lose -1 [Vigor]. Shuffle this card back into the Mortis deck, then resolve the Peril Check again.

grave.name: Stone Scourge
grave.text: Perform a Curse Save (Curse Level +5). Fail: Bane X, where X is the number you failed the Save by.

grave.name: Slime Scourge
grave.text: Perform a Curse Save (Curse Level +4). Fail: Bane X, where X is the number you failed the Save by. Gain the Drowning Condition card.

grave.name: Call of the Graal
grave.text: Gain +2 [Passion] and the Courage Condition card.

grave.name: Knight Counter
grave.text: You may immediately move up to 4 spaces and perform a Bonus Attack! If you have the Knockdown (falling down) Condition card, immediately stand up and move up to 4 spaces instead.

grave.name: Sabotage
grave.text: Discard 2 random cards from your hand. If you couldn't discard any cards, suffer Knockdown.

grave.name: Push the Limit!
grave.text: Stand up. You may reset [Heat] and raise [Heat!] by 3. You may immediately move up to 3 spaces and perform a Bonus Attack!
unclear: second Heat icon has an exclamation mark ([Heat!]) - presumably Heat limit/maximum; transcribed as [Heat!]

grave.name: Disemboweled
grave.text: You die. Shuffle this card back into the Mortis deck.

grave.name: Disemboweled
grave.text: You die. Shuffle this card back into the Mortis deck.

grave.name: Burning Heart
grave.flavor: Bravely we hope, against all hope...
grave.text: Stand up. You may reset [Heat]. You may immediately perform a Bonus Attack!

grave.name: Godly Resolve
grave.text: Discard all Condition cards. If you don't have any, reset [Heat] instead.

grave.name: Disemboweled
grave.text: You die. Shuffle this card back into the Mortis deck.

grave.name: Knight Stand
grave.text: You will probably die—but until then, you will fight with all your being! Immediately stand up, move up to your Speed [Speed] and perform a Bonus Attack! If you deal a Wound, you live! If not, you die. Then, shuffle this card back into the Mortis deck.

grave.name: There Will Be a Reckoning
grave.text: Add the You Died Horribly Judicium to the Judicium deck.

judicium.name: You Died Horribly
judicium.text: Add this card to the Judicium deck if your [Vigor] would drop to -5 below 0.

judicium.name: Your Gruesome Death Becomes Legend
judicium.text: Add this card to the Judicium deck if your [Vigor] would drop to -9 below 0.

judicium.name: Your Death Beckons the Graal
judicium.text: Add this card to the Judicium deck if your [Vigor] would drop to -12 below 0.

judicium.name: Your Death Becomes a Dragon's Sacrament
judicium.flavor: Come not between the Dragon and his wrath.
unclear: No threshold / rules text printed on the card - only the flavor quote. Presumably added by a campaign/story effect rather than a Vigor threshold.
